questions.q:
Will Skyworks Solutions, Inc. (SWKS) have a higher rate of return than Iron Mountain Incorporated (IRM) between {forecast_due_date} and {resolution_date}?

For each resolution date, a stock's rate of return is calculated as its market close price on that date divided by its market close price on {forecast_due_date}, minus one. Prices are adjusted for stock splits and reverse splits. Dividends are not included. If either stock is delisted (e.g., through acquisition, merger, or bankruptcy), the most recent market close price before delisting is used for all subsequent resolution dates. | horizon 2027-10-25

evidence: Dataset family 'yfinance', horizon 2027-10-25: base 0.50 with 30-day momentum tilt +0.01 from freeze changes ['+7.1', '-2.7'].
questions.strongest_opposing_case: Strongest case against: the family rule ignores series-specific news and regime changes; any structural break since the freeze date (war shocks, policy moves, product relists) would move the true probability well away from this base rate.
questions.reasoning_summary: Family base-rate strategy for yfinance at horizon 2027-10-25: base 0.50 with 30-day momentum tilt +0.01 from freeze changes ['+7.1', '-2.7'].
